title: The Secret of the Ten-Thousand-Year Separation
next_chapter_hook: When the threads of destiny intertwine once more, Chen Ji faces the ultimate choice—whether to continue as a broken piece on the board, or embrace the merger that could change everything.

text.content: In the Void, that fragmented scene resembles an ancient painting corroded by time, edges burnt and curled, yet still clearly reflecting the scenery of ten thousand years ago. Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply—at the altar, two identical figures are being torn apart by an invisible giant hand, blood cascading like a waterfall, dyeing half the sky crimson. That face, those contours, are unmistakably identical to his own.

dialogue.content: "Did you see it clearly?" The Demonic Path commander's voice rings in his ear, carrying an indescribable compassion. "That is you and I. No, to be more precise—that is you and I's common source. We were originally one person."

text.content: Chen Ji feels a violent dizziness surge through him, as if some memory sealed for ten thousand years is trying to break through some invisible barrier. His fingertips tremble slightly, and the Tianji Record fragment in his palm suddenly burns like fire. The same soul, one body with two faces—these eight words explode in his mind like thunder.

dialogue.content: "Ten thousand years ago, we were still a complete existence." Ye Qing's figure flickers in the scene, yet her voice is exceptionally clear. "A complete soul, a complete Tianji Record, a complete foresight. However, this power was too formidable, formidable enough to make the Eye of Heavenly Way feel fear."

text.content: The scene flows, and Chen Ji sees that invisible giant hand—the Eye of Heavenly Way—coldly reaching toward the altar. It does not seek to destroy that complete soul, but to tear it living in two. One half injected into the carrier of the Tianji Record, one half cast into the Demonic Path reincarnation. Eternal separation, eternal opposition, eternal inability to recognize each other.

dialogue.content: "What does it fear?" Ye Qing's tone suddenly turns sharp. "It fears that after we merge, we could see through all its arrangements. It fears that after we join forces, the complete power of the Tianji Record would be enough to overturn the entire firmament." She pauses, her voice dropping. "So it split us apart, allowing us to only glimpse three feet of heavenly secrets, yet never see the full picture of destiny."

text.content: Chen Ji stares fixedly at the fragment in his palm—the three characters Tianji Record now appear so glaring. This incomplete version was originally the symbol of a complete soul? Each use consuming Heavenly Fate points was actually using part of his own soul to fill that wound that can never heal?

He suddenly recalls Mo Xiansheng's meaningful words: "The Tianji Record chose you because you are the most suitable half." Chen Ji once thought this was mere comfort, but now it dawns on him—every word was a cruel truth. He was not a chosen lucky one, but a randomly assigned fragment.

dialogue.content: "When I discovered this record at the Holy Sect, I almost thought I was insane." Ye Qing's voice carries a bitter smile. "Two unrelated people, yet their souls resonate so intensely—this is not coincidence, but proof that we are originally one. Separated for ten thousand years, across righteous and demonic paths, yet we reunite today."

text.content: Chen Ji remains silent for a long moment, the surrounding air as if frozen into ice. He recalls his past—theadvance step by step beneath thetrash persona, the precise control over every calculation of fate, and that stabbing pain each time Heavenly Fate was consumed. So from the very beginning, this was not a game between him and destiny, but a cage meticulously designed by the Eye of Heavenly Way.

choice.prompt: Facing this truth that subverts all understanding, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: This is too coincidental—the Demonic Path commander may be deploying a more sophisticated illusion. What does an ancient separation ten thousand years ago matter? The present me is the present me—I will never be shaken by so-called truths.
choices.risk_hint: If the Truth Is True, May Miss the Opportunity to Break the Game

text.content: "Interesting." Chen Ji suddenly laughs lightly, the shock in his eyes ebbing like tidewater, replaced by his usual coldness and scrutiny. "The ancient scenes are indeed stunning, but Demonic Path commander—or rather, Miss Ye Qing—on what grounds should I believe this isn't a more sophisticated illusion?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing is slightly taken aback, then a flash of appreciation crosses her eyes: "You indeed didn't believe immediately. This is the reaction the person I chose should have."

choices.description: The anomalous reactions of the Tianji Record, the coincidental arrangements of fate, and everything the Demonic Path commander has shown now—if all these point to the same truth, is questioning itself part of the chess game?
choices.visible_cost: May Fall Deeper into the Chess Game
choices.visible_reward: Possibility of Obtaining the Complete Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Accepting the Hint Means Acknowledging a Past of Being Manipulated

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closes his eyes, feeling the scalding heat of the fragment in his palm. Heavenly Fate suddenly drains five points, an emptiness spreading through his body, yet at this moment, he perceives a resonance from deep within his soul—as if the distant other half is responding.

dialogue.content: "You felt it." Ye Qing's voice suddenly softens. "That is the bond between us. Ten thousand years of separation couldn't sever it."

text.content: The scene shifts again, and Chen Ji sees the original form of the Tianji Record—a complete jade slip, flowing with Dao patterns throughout, as if containing the secrets of the entire firmament. After the Eye of Heavenly Way tore that complete soul apart, the jade slip shattered as well—one half transforming into the fragment inherited by Tianqing Sect, one half falling into the Demonic Path abyss and becoming the black jade in Ye Qing's hand.

dialogue.content: "After the separation, the Eye of Heavenly Way remained uneasy." Ye Qing's voice carries a chill. "It trapped one of us in a righteous sect, imprisoned the other in a Demonic Holy Sect. Let us be enemies for generations, let us never approach each other. What it fears is never how strong we are, but what we would become if we met."

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly recalls Ling Yuan's vague hostility, Mo Xiansheng's expressions of wanting to speak yet holding back, the deliberately vague records within the Tianji Record. So everyone was merely a piece, and the true chessboard was that cruel separation ten thousand years ago. He clenches his fist, fingernails deeply embedding into his palm.

dialogue.content: "I could find you because of the resonance between the Tianji Record fragments." Ye Qing steps forward, the distance between her and Chen Ji so close they can almost feel each other's breath. "And you perceiving my existence proves that the fragment in your hand has acknowledged this truth. Now, only one question remains—"

text.content: Something fierce burns in her eyes: "Do you wish to continue as a broken piece, struggling to survive in the Eye of Heavenly Way's chess game? Or—" Ye Qing slowly raises her hand, the black jade in her palm facing Chen Ji's fragment across the distance, both emanating the same ancient and desolate aura, "—unite with us, and completely overturn this game?"

choice.prompt: Ten thousand years of destiny lies before him—Chen Ji must respond:

choices.description: Merger sounds beautiful, but what does merging two souls mean? Chen Ji needs to know the complete truth before making a judgment.
choices.risk_hint: Inquiring May Let the Other Side Detect Your Uncertainty

text.content: "Sounds very tempting." Chen Ji's tone is terrifyingly calm. "But Demonic Path commander—no, Miss Ye Qing, you've omitted one thing. Merging two souls—what does it mean? Does one side disappear, or do we both become a third existence?"

dialogue.content: Ye Qing falls silent for a moment—this is the first time she has shown a wavering expression before Chen Ji: "...I don't know. The records from ten thousand years ago don't mention this point. But what I know is—if we don't merge, the Eye of Heavenly Way will eventually crush us one by one."

choices.description: Even if it's the other half of the same soul, Chen Ji will never hand over the decision of his destiny to others. The Eye of Heavenly Way is the enemy, but that doesn't mean this woman before him is a friend.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain Independent Status, Not Controlled by Others
choices.risk_hint: May Anger the Demonic Path Commander

text.content: "Even if it's the other half of the same soul, so what?" Chen Ji's voice suddenly turns cold, his aura changing dramatically—the image of the pathetictrash servant disciple completely collapsing at this moment. "Ten thousand years ago was ten thousand years ago. Now is now. My destiny is determined solely by myself."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's smile freezes on her face, then transforms into a sigh: "As expected... you're as stubborn as I imagined. Very well, this was within expectations."

choices.description: The possibility of merger cannot be shut off, but this is absolutely not the moment for a decision. Chen Ji needs time, more intelligence, confirmation whether this is part of a larger chess game.
choices.risk_hint: The Other Side May Not Give You Much Time to Consider

text.content: Chen Ji doesn't answer immediately, but tucks the fragment back into his sleeve, movements composed and unhurried: "Your proposal is interesting. But before that, I need to confirm one thing—why did the Eye of Heavenly Way want to separate us? What exactly does it truly fear?"

dialogue.content: A sharp glint flashes in Ye Qing's eyes: "You're indeed smarter than you appear. Indeed, this is the key question—what did the complete soul ten thousand years ago see?"

text.content: At this moment, the scene in the void shifts again. Chen Ji sees on the altar ten thousand years ago, that complete soul gazing at the firmament—at that invisible giant eye. Complete foresight allows it to see one ultimate truth: at the end of the Tianji Record, the power is not to foresee the future, but to rewrite the past. When two half-souls merge, it is the moment to rewrite the ten-thousand-year seal.

dialogue.content: "So you see it now?" Ye Qing's voice seems to echo from antiquity. "The Eye of Heavenly Way separated us, not for punishment, but for self-preservation. Once we merge, the sins it committed ten thousand years ago will be completely erased—it will cease to exist."

text.content: Chen Ji finally understands. The separation ten thousand years ago was not judgment, but imprisonment. The Eye of Heavenly Way transferred its crimes onto two innocent souls, making them enemies for generations, letting them consume each other in endless strife. It is not some impartial heavenly principle, but the greatest criminal beneath this firmament.

He suddenly bursts into laughter, the sound echoing through the empty void, carrying an indescribable sense of畅快 anddesolate. trash Chen Ji, servant disciple, the meticulous strategist—turns out from the very beginning, he was merely a piece in some criminal's hand. Destiny? Heavenly Principle? Nothing but a sky-reaching lie. And now, the fragments of that lie are gradually taking shape in his hands.

dialogue.content: "What are you laughing at?" Ye Qing slightly frowns.

text.content: Chen Ji stops laughing, yet the coldness in his eyes is even more intense than before: "I'm laughing at how ridiculous this Heavenly Way is. Ten thousand years ago it went to great lengths to split us apart, thinking this would forever prevent future troubles. It didn't know that every move it made brings us closer to the truth." He slowly raises his head, his gaze blazing. "Ye Qing, there's no need to rush about the merger. But as for joining hands against the Eye of Heavenly Way—I agree."

Ye Qing stares at him blankly, seemingly not having expected him to give such an answer. After a moment, the corner of her mouth slightly lifts, revealing a genuine smile—this is the first time Chen Ji sees her shed all pretense: "Good. Then let us first overturn this chess game. As for merger... when the time comes, you will know."

In the void, that scene from ten thousand years ago slowly fades away. The bloodstains on the altar gradually dissipate, the two torn figures dissolving into countless scattered lights, ultimately merging into the fragment in Chen Ji's palm and the black jade in Ye Qing's hand. The grievances spanning ten thousand years pause at this moment, yet the true ending has yet to arrive.
